messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can take advantage of in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend without the need for an extra day off.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 20 2023** (Mon) | **Family Day** (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 18 – Mon 20). |
| **Apr 7 2023** (Fri) | **Good Friday** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 7 – Sun 9). |
| **May 22 2023** (Mon) | **Victoria Day** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 20 – Mon 22). |
| **Jul 1 2023** (Sat) | **Canada Day** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 1 – Sun 2). |
| **Sep 4 2023** (Mon) | **Labour Day** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 2 – Mon 4). |
| **Oct 9 2023** (Mon) | **Thanksgiving** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 7 – Mon 9). |
| **Nov 11 2023** (Sat) | **Remembrance Day** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 11 – Sun 12). |
| **Dec 25 2023** (Mon) | **Christmas Day** (all provinces) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 23 – Mon 25). |

### Provincial/territorial extras that also create long weekends

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long‑weekend? |
|--------------------|---------|------|---------------|
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **St. Patrick’s Day** | **Mar 17 2023** (Fri) | Yes (Fri 17 – Sun 19) |
| Ontario | **St. Patrick’s Day** (statutory holiday in some municipalities) | Mar 17 2023 (Fri) | Yes (if observed) |
| British Columbia | **St. Patrick’s Day** (statutory holiday in some municipalities) | Mar 17 2023 (Fri) | Yes (if observed) |

> **Tip:** Some provinces (e.g., Ontario, British Columbia) also observe **St. Patrick’s Day** as a statutory holiday in certain municipalities, so you may want to check local calendars if you’re planning trips there.

---

#### Quick‑look calendar view

```
Feb 2023
Sat 18  Sun 19  Mon 20  Family Day (long weekend)

Apr 2023
Fri 7   Good Friday (long weekend)
Sat 8   Sun 9

May 2023
Sat 20  Sun 21  Mon 22  Victoria Day (long weekend)

Jul 2023
Sat 1   Sun 2   Canada Day (long weekend)

Sep 2023
Sat 2   Sun 3   Mon 4   Labour Day (long weekend)

Oct 2023
Sat 7   Sun 8   Mon 9   Thanksgiving (long weekend)

Nov 2023
Sat 11  Sun 12  Remembrance Day (long weekend)

Dec 2023
Sat 23  Sun 24  Mon 25  Christmas Day (long weekend)
```

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
